an7.61:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Bhaggesu viharati Suṃsumāragire Bhesakaḷāvane Migadāye.
an7.61:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno Magadhesu Kallavāḷamuttagāme pacalāyamāno nisinno hoti.
an7.61:1.4: Addasā kho Bhagavā dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena āyasmantaṃ Mahāmoggallānaṃ Magadhesu Kallavāḷamuttagāme pacalāyamānaṃ nisinnaṃ,
an7.61:1.6: seyyathā pi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya, evam eva Bhaggesu Suṃsumāragire Bhesakaḷāvane Migadāye antarahito Magadhesu Kallavāḷamuttagāme āyasmato Mahāmoggallānassa pamukhe pāturahosi.
an7.61:1.8: Nisajja kho Bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Mahāmoggallānaṃ etad avoca
an7.61:2.1: ‘pacalāyasi no tvaṃ Moggallāna, pacalāyasi no tvaṃ Moggallānā' ti?
an7.61:2.3: Tasmā ti ha tvaṃ Moggallāna, yathā saññissa te viharato taṃ middhaṃ okkamati, taṃ saññaṃ manasākāsi taṃ saññaṃ bahulam akāsi:
an7.61:2.4: ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ vijjati, yan te evaṃ viharato taṃ middhaṃ pahīyetha. 3.
an7.61:3.1: No ce te evaṃ viharato taṃ middhaṃ pahīyetha, tato tvaṃ Moggallāna yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ cetasā anuvitakkeyyāsi anuvicāreyyāsi manasānupekkheyyāsi:
an7.61:3.2: ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ vijjati, yan te evaṃ viharato taṃ middhaṃ pahīyetha. 4.
an7.61:4.1: No ce te evaṃ viharato taṃ middhaṃ pahīyetha, tato tvaṃ Moggallāna yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ vitthārena sajjhāyaṃ kareyyāsi:
an7.61:4.2: ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ vijjati, yan te evaṃ viharato taṃ middhaṃ pahīyetha. 5.
an7.61:5.1: No ce te evaṃ viharato taṃ middhaṃ pahīyetha, tato tvaṃ Moggallāna ubho kaṇṇasotāni āvijeyyāsi pāṇinā gattāni anumajjeyyāsi:
an7.61:5.2: ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ vijjati, yan te evaṃ viharato taṃ middhaṃ pahīyetha. 6.
an7.61:6.1: No ce te evaṃ viharato taṃ middhaṃ pahīyetha, tato tvaṃ Moggallāna uṭṭhāyāsanā udakena akkhīni anumajjitvā disā anuvilokeyyāsi nakkhattāni tārakarūpāni ullokeyyāsi:
an7.61:6.2: ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ vijjati, yan te evaṃ viharato taṃ middhaṃ pahīyetha. 7.
an7.61:7.1: No ce te evaṃ viharato tam middhaṃ pahīyetha, tato tvaṃ Moggallāna ālokasaññaṃ manasikareyyāsi divāsaññaṃ adhiṭṭheyyāsi;
an7.61:7.2: yathā divā tathā rattiṃ, yathā rattiṃ tathā divā.
an7.61:7.3: Iti vivaṭena cetasā apariyonaddhena sappabhāsaṃ cittaṃ bhāveyyāsi:
an7.61:7.4: ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ vijjati, yan te evaṃ viharato taṃ middhaṃ pahīyetha. 8.
an7.61:8.1: No ce te evaṃ viharato taṃ middhaṃ pahīyetha, tato tvaṃ Moggallāna pacchāpuresaññī caṅkamaṃ adhiṭṭheyyāsi antogatehi indriyehi abahigatena mānasena:
an7.61:8.2: ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ vijjati, yan te evaṃ viharato taṃ middhaṃ pahīyetha. 9.
an7.61:9.1: No ce te evaṃ viharato taṃ middhaṃ pahīyetha, tato tvaṃ Moggallāna dakkhiṇena passena sīhaseyyaṃ kappeyyāsi pādena pādaṃ accādhāya sato sampajāno uṭṭhānasaññaṃ manasikaritvā,
an7.61:9.2: paṭibuddhena ca te Moggallāna khippaṃ yeva paccuṭṭhātabbaṃ
an7.61:9.3: ‘na seyyasukhaṃ na passasukhaṃ na middhasukhaṃ anuyutto viharissāmī' ti. Evaṃ
an7.61:10.1: Tasmā ti ha Moggallāna evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ
an7.61:10.2: ‘na uccāsoṇḍaṃ paggahetvā kulāni upasaṅkamissāmī' ti. Evaṃ
an7.61:10.4: Sace Moggallāna bhikkhu uccāsoṇḍaṃ paggahetvā kulāni upasaṅkamati, santi hi Moggallāna kulesu kiccakaraṇīyāni,
an7.61:10.5: yena manussā āgataṃ bhikkhuṃ na manasikaronti, tatra bhikkhussa evaṃ hoti
an7.61:10.6: ‘ko su nāma dāni maṃ imasmiṃ kule paribhindi, virattarūpādānīme mayi manussā' ti,
an7.61:10.7: iti 'ssa alābhena maṅkubhāvo, maṅkubhūtassa uddhaccaṃ, uddhatassa asaṃvaro, asaṃvutassa ārā cittaṃ samādhimhā.
an7.61:11.1: Tasmā ti ha Moggallāna evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ
an7.61:11.4: Viggāhikāya Moggallāna kathāya sati kathābāhullaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ, kathābāhulle sati uddhaccaṃ, uddhatassa asaṃvaro, asaṃvutassa ārā cittaṃ samādhimhā.
an7.61:11.5: Nāhaṃ Moggallāna sabbe h' eva saṃsaggaṃ vaṇṇayāmi,
an7.61:11.6: na panāhaṃ Moggallāna sabbe h' eva saṃsaggaṃ na vaṇṇayāmi,
an7.61:11.7: sagahaṭṭhapabbajitehi kho ahaṃ Moggallāna saṃsaggaṃ na vaṇṇayāmi,
an7.61:11.8: yāni ca kho tāni senāsanāni appasaddāni appanigghosāni vijanavātāni manussarāhaseyyakāni paṭisallānasāruppāni, tathārūpehi senāsanehi saṃsaggaṃ vaṇṇayāmī' ti. 11.
an7.61:12.1: Evaṃ vutte āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an7.61:12.2: ‘kittāvatā nu kho bhante bhikkhu saṃkhittena taṇhāsaṃkhayavimutto hoti accantaniṭṭho accantayogakkhemī accantabrahmacārī accantapariyosāno seṭṭho devamanussānan' ti?
an7.61:13.3: evañ c' etaṃ Moggallāna bhikkhuno sutaṃ hoti:
an7.61:13.5: So sabbaṃ dhammaṃ abhijānāti, sabbaṃ dhammaṃ abhiññāya sabbaṃ dhammaṃ parijānāti, sabbaṃ dhammaṃ pariññāya yaṃ kiñci vedanaṃ vediyati sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā.
an7.61:13.6: So tāsu vedanāsu aniccānupassī viharati, virāgānupassī viharati, nirodhānupassī viharati, paṭinissaggānupassī viharati.
an7.61:13.7: So tāsu vedanāsu aniccānupassī viharanto virāgānupassī viharanto nirodhānupassī viharanto paṭinissaggānupassī viharanto na ca kiñci loke upādiyati,
an7.61:13.8: anupādiyaṃ na paritassati, aparitassaṃ paccattaṃ yeva parinibbāyati;
an7.61:13.9: "khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā" ti pajānāti.
an7.61:13.10: Ettāvatā kho Moggallāna bhikkhu saṃkhittena taṇhāsaṃkhayavimutto hoti accantaniṭṭho accantayogakkhemī accantabrahmacārī accantapariyosāno seṭṭho devamanussānan'
